craft_notes: Sthāyin: the map — catalogue as chant. Rows: 2 (catalogue roll kept whole, six names unbroken). Rejected: glossing yāmala as couple-love — killed: technical term, kept whole. Read aloud: six-beat roll call.

lines: In this stance stands the Kula rite, sixfold:
without, in Śakti, in your own frame, in the pair, in breath, in knowing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tad anayā sthityā kulayāgaḥ sa ca ṣoḍhā bāhye śaktau svadehe yāmale prāṇe saṃvidi ca iti
